purpose: Distinct licence records per kind of thing RasanAI ships, bundles, fetches or studies. Missing licence = unresolved, never permission. Rechecked against the actual files by lib/license-register.mjs inventory().

distribution_blockers.scope: project-wide distribution of RasanAI (skill, Studio bundle, website copy) while it ships and writes against GSAP and exposes direct element editing
distribution_blockers.reason: GSAP's Standard License includes a restriction aimed at competing no-code visual animation builders. Applicability to RasanAI's actual product (Studio's element inspector writes source through typed edits; it is not a timeline builder, but that reading is ours, not a licensor's) has not been assessed with licensing advice or written permission.
not_resolved_by: a feature flag or environment variable
distribution_blockers.cleared_by: recorded licensing advice or written permission, then a dated edit here and in docs/plans/motion-studio-licenses.md

records.name: RasanAI skill and engine code
records.scope: our own code only; the MIT licence does not cover the other records in this register, and an MIT repository badge does not license external assets or a separately sold skill pack

records.name: GSAP core
records.header_evidence: @license Copyright 2025, GreenSock. All rights reserved. Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license
restrictions: the Standard License restricts use inside a no-code visual animation builder that competes with GSAP's own tools
the same page permits AI-generated code and distinguishes noncompeting visual tools
records.redistribution: vendored unmodified, header kept; the full licence text was NOT verified in this repository (gsap.com returned a marketing page on 2026-10-24)
records.action: a project-wide review with licensing advice or written permission from GreenSock for RasanAI's actual product and distribution; the runtime is NOT removed and no flag, label or checkbox is treated as resolving it

records.name: Fonts fetched or staged for a film (Google Fonts via lib/fonts.mjs, user brand fonts)
records.scope: each family has its own licence (often OFL or Apache-2.0); a user's brand font belongs to its foundry
records.action: record the family's licence in the film's brand manifest when it is fetched or imported; a font without a recorded licence stays unresolved and is not redistributed in an export package

records.name: Music tracks resolved by music.mjs (mirrors, CC-BY and similar)
records.scope: each track keeps its own licence and attribution duty; the catalog row, not the repository licence, decides
records.action: a track without a recorded licence is unresolved and is not delivered

records.name: Audio, image and video produced by hosted generators (ElevenLabs, Stability, others)
records.scope: output rights depend on the provider's terms and the person's plan; not read here
records.action: record the plan and terms version per project before commercial delivery

records.name: Generation model weights for the optional ComfyUI path
records.scope: no weights are bundled or downloaded by RasanAI; each film records hybrid/model-licences.json by hand (lib/provider-jobs.mjs modelLicense); no record means unreviewed
